cards.front: Recall a key point about Electricity and Circuits
cards.back: Ohm: V = IR (ohmic) vs non-ohmic (filament, diode); I-V curves

cards.front: Recall a key point about Electricity and Circuits
cards.back: Series: I same, V splits, R_total = ΣR; Parallel: V same, I splits, 1/R_total = Σ1/R

cards.front: Recall a key point about Electricity and Circuits
cards.back: Power: P = IV = I^2R = V^2/R; Energy: E = Pt = IVt

cards.front: Recall a key point about Electricity and Circuits
cards.back: Kirchhoff 1st (junction): ΣI_in = ΣI_out (charge conservation); 2nd (loop): ΣV = 0 (energy conservation)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Electricity and Circuits
cards.back: EMF ε = I(R + r); Terminal PD V = ε - Ir; r = internal resistance

cards.front: Recall a key point about Electricity and Circuits
cards.back: Potential divider: V_out = V_in x R₂/(R₁+R₂); used for sensors

cards.front: Recall a key point about Electricity and Circuits
cards.back: AC: I = I₀sin(ωt), V = V₀sin(ωt+φ); V_rms = V₀/sqrt2, I_rms = I₀/sqrt2

cards.front: Recall a key point about Electricity and Circuits
cards.back: Capacitive reactance Xc = 1/(ωC); Inductive Xl = ωL; Impedance Z = sqrt(R^2+(Xl-Xc)^2)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Electricity and Circuits
cards.back: Resonance: Xl = Xc -> Z_min = R, ω₀ = 1/sqrt(LC)
